info.name: Sonarfy - Album details
info.description: Authenticated album details contract: docs/api/albums.md. Set baseUrl, accessToken and albumSpotifyId locally. Reading an unknown album may persist catalog metadata. No review writes. Provider failures are exercised by the integration tests against the versioned Postman simulation.

exec: pm.test('Public album contract', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.all.keys('spotifyId','name','coverUrl','artist','releaseOn','releasePrecision','totalTracks','averageRating','reviewCount'); pm.expect(b.spotifyId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('albumSpotifyId')); pm.expect(b.artist).to.have.all.keys('spotifyId','name'); pm.expect(b.totalTracks).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(b.reviewCount).to.be.at.least(0); if (b.reviewCount === 0) pm.expect(b.averageRating).to.eql(null); else { pm.expect(b.averageRating).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(b.averageRating).to.be.at.most(10); } });
